author: Fareed
description: Per-user gambling threads to keep the shared bot channel clean, plus the Wondercasino hub: a read-only channel with a persistent button/dropdown menu (.gamblehub) that routes players into personal or shared threads instead of letting them post directly. .gamble opens a private thread; it auto-closes after inactivity or .endgambling.
short: Per-user gambling threads plus the Wondercasino hub menu.
